Oneliner

Low-cost and easily replaceable imaging spacecraft that can produce tactically relevant imagery data.
Description

Low-cost and easily replaceable imaging spacecraft that can produce tactically relevant imagery data. Tactical requirements in this context would emphasize “good enough” image resolution with a rapid-response tasking loop and high revisit rate.
